title: Verify research routes and never turn a placeholder into a timestamp
problem: Publish a new research round so its derivation is discoverable and its checkpoint records only time precision supported by evidence.
failure: R04's derivation was initially omitted from the lane's Rounds list. The first Library-card branch added both files but its index edit matched the wrong R02/R03 label, so the card index still omitted them at first readback. A checkpoint heading also used `18:xx UTC`, a placeholder rather than an observed clock time.
correction: HORUS review caught the missing derivation route; add it under Rounds and read the target back. The first Library index readback exposed the missed card-list insertion; add both exact card filenames and verify the rows. Preserve the timestamp mistake append-only and state that the date is known but exact time unavailable. Keep session/task identifiers UNKNOWN/UNREGISTERED when not exposed.
transfer: After writing files, verify each exact index row points to a readable target before claiming discoverability. Record only measured timestamp precision; if a placeholder slips into a record, preserve the original and append a correction with evidence status.
limits: Observed in one ARGO-Research R04 route and checkpoint. The correction establishes the facts of that documentation incident only; it does not validate a universal process improvement or promote a governance rule.
author: TOTO
verifier: HORUS internal analytical collaboration agent; exact-head review, not human review
